_doc: Initial detector input for SJ County 2009-2 — REAL CDIAC YFSR pulled in full. Yellow-zone V/L, Teeter masking.

value_to_lien_collapse._note: 3.49x is above 3x yellow threshold but barely. Watch trend over time.

delinquency_spike._note: Zero unpaid because of Teeter plan — county advances 100% of taxes. This MASKS underlying delinquency from bondholders. Need to pull county tax-collector data for true underlying.

buildout_stalled.source: Vernalis Interchange is infrastructure, not housing — buildout concept doesn't apply cleanly

top_taxpayer_concentration.source: would need OS pull from 2012 issuance

coverage_ratio_thin.source: estimated from $2.53M annual tax / ~$1.5M annual DS on $20M par at 6%

developer_bankruptcy.source: would need OS top-taxpayer list verified against credit databases

_notes: Clean filing-wise. Yellow zone on V/L but does not breach the 3x or 2x fire thresholds. Teeter masking the underlying delinquency is a structural concern but doesn't fire any individual detector.
